subject: Need help on drawing multiple points in same plot

messages.author: ea4e687a14dc225c
messages.subject: Need help on drawing multiple points in same plot
parts:
Hi,

I was trying to create a plot like below :

library(ggplot2)
normal <- rnorm(1000); tdist <- rt(1000, 4)
dat <- data.frame(normal, tdist)
dat1 <- melt(dat)
ggplot(dat1) + stat_bin(aes(x = value, y = ..count../sum(..count..),
fill = variable), alpha = 60/100)

dat2 <- data.frame(x = c(mean(normal), quantile(normal, 0.05), mean
(tdist), quantile(tdist, 0.05)),
y = rep(0, 4),
Pallet1 = factor(c(0, 1, 0, 1), labels = c("Mean",
"Quantile")),
Pallet2 = factor(c(0, 0, 1, 1), labels = c
("Normal", "tDist"))); dat2

last_plot() + geom_point(aes(x = x, y = y, colour = Pallet1, shape =
Pallet2), data = dat2, size = 5)


Here I want to plot both Average & Percentile of Normal & t-
distribution in same plot with appropriate colour.

However I am getting following error while executing :

Error in col2rgb(colour, TRUE) : invalid color name 'Mean'

Can anyone here please point me where I am making mistake?

Thanks,

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: Need help on drawing multiple points in same plot
parts:
Hi Megh,

For some reason the colour scale isn't getting added on automatically.
If you add it on yourself, it works:

variable), alpha = 60/100) +
geom_point(aes(x = x, y = 0, colour = Pallet1, shape = Pallet2),
size = 5, data = dat2) + scale_colour_discrete()

However, I can't see why this isn't happening automatically. When I
rewrite the way I'd do it, it works fine:

dist <- data.frame(
dist = gl(2, 1000, labels = c("t", "normal")),
value = c(rt(1000, 4), rnorm(1000)))

summary <- melt(ddply(dist, c("dist"), summarise,
mean = mean(value),
median = median(value)))

ggplot(dist, aes(value)) +
stat_bin(aes(fill = dist), binwidth = 1) +
geom_point(data = summary, aes(y = 0, colour = dist, shape = variable))

I can't see what the difference is :(

Hadley
